description: Free desktop app and MCP server that brings Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or any AI agent into the mailbox you already have: Outlook/Microsoft 365, Gmail, IMAP. Search, attachments, drafts, calendar. Nothing is sent without your approval, given outside the agent's reach. Runs on your PC (Windows, macOS, Linux), no cloud.
